endorsements.name: Ahmed Rayen Ayari
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12353
endorsements.description: The WPFunnels – The Easiest Funnel Builder For WordPress And WooCommerce To Collect Leads And Increase Sales plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized user registration in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.2. This is due to the plugin relying on a user controlled value 'optin_allow_registration' to determine if user registration is allowed, instead of the site-specific setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register new user accounts, even when user registration is disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Ahmed Rayen Ayari
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12809
endorsements.description: The Dokan Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of data due to a missing capability check on the `/dokan/v1/wholesale/register` REST API endpoint in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.3. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to enumerate users and retrieve their email addresses via the REST API by providing a user ID, along with other information such as usernames, display names, user roles, and registration dates.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Ahmed Rayen Ayari
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12886
endorsements.description: The Oxygen Theme theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.8 via the laborator_calc_route AJAX action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to make web requests to arbitrary locations originating from the web application and can be used to query and modify information from internal services.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)

endorsements.name: Ahmed Rayen Ayari
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12895
endorsements.description: The Kalium 3 | Creative WordPress & WooCommerce Theme theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized email sending due to a missing capability check on the kalium_vc_contact_form_request() function in all versions up to, and including, 3.29. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to use the theme an an open mail relay and send email to arbitrary email addresses on the server's behalf.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)
